name: NewAthena
full_name: New Advanced Telescope for High Energy Astrophysics
summary: ESA's restructured large X-ray-observatory project. High-resolution spectroscopy can test keV dark-matter decay, but early Athena forecasts cannot be used directly as the performance of the revised configuration.
detection_principle: High-throughput X-ray mirrors, X-IFU microcalorimeters and wide-field imaging search dark-matter-rich targets for narrow lines.

sites.name: Future space-observation orbit, subject to ESA's design

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
